rules: Isabel must never appear frozen while waiting.
Idle motion must stay subtle and professional.
Do not loop one obvious animation on a short timer.
Do not have Isabel stare at the arrival camera before a user is present.
Eyes lead the head to avoid robotic simultaneous motion.
Do not snap the whole torso toward the camera.
If Isabel is walking, she should slow and establish stable footing before greeting.
If Isabel is speaking to another task, defer greeting until the current speech boundary.
Sustained perfect eye contact is not natural; allow short breaks.
Listening motion must not compete with speech content.
Expression intensity remains restrained unless the conversation calls for more emotion.
